title: The workflow is a {{amber:funnel}}: discover many, score the worthwhile, analyze the few
headSub: Width is a human decision bounded by a cost ceiling (ADR-061), not a fixed cap. Per-job accuracy and focus rise left to right.

takeaway.text: Pay the most only where it matters: the {{green:few}} jobs that clear the bar get the expensive deep review, not the {{blue:many}} that were merely discovered.
